run.change_description: Enable Flow typings on errors tests + Fix typing for Error constructor

summary.intent: Enable `@flow strict` on the error and inspect tests and widen the `GraphQLError` constructor typing so `nodes` accepts `null`, as the supplied PR text's review thread asks.
summary.issue_fit: Partial. No originating issue exists; the intent source is the commit message and the supplied PR text. The `null` typing is met; the Flow enablement is not verifiable offline, and the rewrite of one test loses its stackless-error coverage.
summary.coverage: All five changed files reviewed against the complete merge-base diff. The four changed test files pass at head (27 passing, mocha run once). A scratch-copy mutation showed the merge-base no-stack test fails and the head version passes. Flow was not run: the run allowance permits only mocha, so whether the new annotations, `any` casts and the `$FlowFixMe` type-check is unverified.
coverage_gaps: Flow type-check of the five changed files was not run (allowance permits only mocha); supplying a Flow run at head would settle whether the new annotations, `any` casts and `$FlowFixMe` are accepted and closes requirement `commit-7e39a12/"Enable Flow typings on errors tests"`.

findings.title: Keep the stackless originalError case in the no-stack test
findings.trigger: Change `if (originalError && originalError.stack)` in `src/error/GraphQLError.js` to `if (originalError)`, so a stackless `originalError` yields `stack` undefined.
findings.impact: The test `creates new stack if original error has no stack` now builds `new Error('original')`, which always has a stack, so it takes the `originalError.stack` branch. It still passes on that mutation (13 passing) where the merge-base fixture `{ message: 'original' }` failed it, so the regression protection its name claims is gone.
findings.change: In that test, use a stackless original, for example `const original: any = new Error('original'); original.stack = undefined;`, and keep the assertions unchanged. Confirm Flow accepts the fixture.

observations.fact: The `GraphQLError` function implementation still declares `nodes?: $ReadOnlyArray<ASTNode> | ASTNode | void`; only the `declare class` signature gained `| null`, and the runtime already handles null.

requirements.source: commit-7e39a12/"Enable Flow typings on errors tests"
requirements.evidence: src/error/__tests__/GraphQLError-test.js:9, locatedError-test.js:9, printError-test.js:7 and inspect-test.js:7 switch @noflow to @flow strict; Flow was not run offline.
src/error/GraphQLError.js:25 adds `| null` to the declared `nodes` parameter; tests pass null at runtime.

unrecoverable_inputs: Flow type-check of the changed files (offline allowance permits only mocha); could change whether the new annotations, `any` casts and `$FlowFixMe` are accepted.
